text:
marta: quick heads-up: new canary for 'vanguard-2q' (int8) shows parse failures in toolcall suite — spike from 0.8% -> 6.1% around 09:30 UTC.
ryan: what slice and config?
marta: bench ran 5k toolcall slice (id: tc-2026-03-23). model=vanguard-2q, quant=int8, batch=8, kv_cache=enabled, stream=on, kernel=attn_v2.
bench-ci: run summary:
```
job: bc-1767
samples: 5000
parse_failure_rate: 0.061
err_mode: trailing-data / duplicate-json
```
ash: paste sanitized failure sample?
marta: example:
{"action":"call","name":"get_profile","arguments":{"id":"42"}}}

{"action":"call","name":"get_profile","arguments":{"id":"43"}}

ryan: extra brace then repeated JSON -> suggests streaming or cache replay dup.
samir: note: int8 quant + kv_cache replay could change token ranks causing stray '}' tokens. we've seen similar with other int8 canaries.
marta: triage plan: A) reproduce with kv_cache off B) reproduce with int16 C) add temporary SDK postprocess to try suffix-trim on parse failure and tag telemetry.
ash: i'll run (B) + matrix for stream true/false. samir, can you run (A) and add a metric for kv_cache_blocked?
samir: kicking job bc-1768: kv_cache=false, limit=1000.
infra-bot: alert (canary): parse_failure_rate > 5% for 10m — routing blocked for this model in promotion pipeline.
bench-ci: bc-1768 interim: parse_failure = 0.014 after 1k samples -> kv_cache looks causal.
ryan: good signal. implement gating: runtime should block kv_cache for models with quant=int8 until we patch kernel/runtime.
marta: also add SDK soft-repair: on parse error try trimming trailing non-json up to 128 chars then reparse; mark repaired calls with header x-json-repaired. ash can ship small patch to canary SDK.
nash: we'll run full 5k with repairs=true, kv_cache=false and compute repaired_success and false_repair against gold.
bench-ci: bc-1769 completed: overall parse_fail down to 0.009; repaired_success ~0.054; false_repair estimate 0.002 on gold subset. logs: https://bench.internal/runs/bc-1769/logs
ryan: owners: samir -> runtime kv_cache gating + metric, ash -> SDK repair and telemetry tagging, marta -> routing block/product note, ryan -> dashboard and postmortem.
marta: saving minimal failing examples to S3 bucket for golden set. will keep routing block for 24h and revisit when <1%.
nash: adding unit tests to canary harness for streaming-split cases.
marta: thanks all. closing when dashboard stable.
